queries.sql: WITH cs_brand AS (SELECT i.i_brand, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_sales, SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS cs_discount, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS cs_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand), ss_brand AS (SELECT i.i_brand, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_sales, SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS ss_discount, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS ss_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_brand), combined_brand AS (SELECT COALESCE(cs.i_brand, ss.i_brand) AS brand, COALESCE(cs.cs_sales,0) + COALESCE(ss.ss_sales,0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(cs.cs_discount,0) + COALESCE(ss.ss_discount,0) AS total_discount, COALESCE(cs.cs_profit,0) + COALESCE(ss.ss_profit,0) AS total_profit FROM cs_brand cs FULL OUTER JOIN ss_brand ss ON cs.i_brand = ss.i_brand) SELECT brand, total_sales, total_discount, total_profit, CASE WHEN total_discount / NULLIF(total_sales,0) > 0.2 THEN 'High Discount' WHEN total_discount / NULLIF(total_sales,0) > 0.1 THEN 'Medium Discount' ELSE 'Low Discount' END AS discount_category, total_profit / NULLIF(total_discount,0) AS profit_per_discount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_profit / NULLIF(total_discount,0) DESC) AS profit_per_discount_rank FROM combined_brand WHERE total_sales > 0 ORDER BY profit_per_discount_rank LIMIT 20

WITH store_profit AS (SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS cust_id, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_profit FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk), catalog_profit AS (SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS cust_id, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_profit FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk), return_loss AS (SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS cust_id, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS return_loss FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk) SELECT COALESCE(sp.cust_id, cp.cust_id, rl.cust_id) AS customer_id, COALESCE(sp.store_profit, 0) AS store_profit, COALESCE(cp.catalog_profit, 0) AS catalog_profit, COALESCE(rl.return_loss, 0) AS return_loss, (COALESCE(sp.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(cp.catalog_profit,0) - COALESCE(rl.return_loss,0)) AS net_total, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(sp.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(cp.catalog_profit,0) - COALESCE(rl.return_loss,0)) > 0 THEN 'Positive' ELSE 'Negative' END AS net_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(sp.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(cp.catalog_profit,0) - COALESCE(rl.return_loss,0)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM store_profit sp FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_profit cp ON sp.cust_id = cp.cust_id FULL OUTER JOIN return_loss rl ON COALESCE(sp.cust_id, cp.cust_id) = rl.cust_id WHERE (COALESCE(sp.store_profit, 0) + COALESCE(cp.catalog_profit,0) - COALESCE(rl.return_loss,0)) <> 0 ORDER BY net_total DESC LIMIT 50

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_sold_qty FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk) SELECT i.i_category, i.i_item_id, sa.total_sold_qty, ra.total_return_qty, (ra.total_return_qty * 1.0) / NULLIF(sa.total_sold_qty,0) AS return_rate, CASE WHEN (ra.total_return_qty * 1.0) / NULLIF(sa.total_sold_qty,0) > 0.3 THEN 'High Return' WHEN (ra.total_return_qty * 1.0) / NULLIF(sa.total_sold_qty,0) > 0.1 THEN 'Medium Return' ELSE 'Low Return' END AS return_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category ORDER BY (ra.total_return_qty * 1.0) / NULLIF(sa.total_sold_qty,0) DESC) AS return_rate_rank FROM item i LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON i.i_item_sk = sa.ss_item_sk LEFT JOIN returns_agg ra ON i.i_item_sk = ra.sr_item_sk WHERE sa.total_sold_qty IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.i_category, return_rate_rank LIMIT 100

SELECT ss.ss_store_sk AS store_id, ss.ss_promo_sk AS promo_id, i.i_category, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_returns_amount, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, (SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) - SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)) AS net_gain, CASE WHEN (SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) - SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)) > 0 THEN 'Gain' ELSE 'Loss' END AS gain_loss_flag, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) - SUM(sr.sr_net_loss)) DESC) AS store_gain_rank FROM store_sales ss JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_promo_sk, i.i_category HAVING SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) > 500 ORDER BY net_gain DESC LIMIT 30

WITH combined_sales AS (SELECT i.i_category, i.i_item_id, i.i_item_sk, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS catalog_sales, SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_profit FROM catalog_sales cs JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_category, i.i_item_id, i.i_item_sk) SELECT i_category, i_item_id, (catalog_sales + store_sales) AS total_sales, (catalog_profit + store_profit) AS total_profit, (catalog_profit + store_profit) / NULLIF((catalog_sales + store_sales), 0) AS profit_margin, CASE WHEN (catalog_profit + store_profit) / NULLIF((catalog_sales + store_sales), 0) > 0.5 THEN 'High' WHEN (catalog_profit + store_profit) / NULLIF((catalog_sales + store_sales), 0) > 0.2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS margin_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY (catalog_profit + store_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM combined_sales WHERE (catalog_sales + store_sales) > 1000 ORDER BY i_category, profit_rank

WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS catalog_sales, 0 AS store_sales, 0 AS returns_amount FROM catalog_sales cs GROUP BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk UNION ALL SELECT ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, 0 AS catalog_sales, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales, 0 AS returns_amount FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_sold_date_sk UNION ALL SELECT sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, 0 AS catalog_sales, 0 AS store_sales, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS returns_amount FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_returned_date_sk), aggregated_monthly AS (SELECT date_sk, SUM(catalog_sales) AS total_catalog_sales, SUM(store_sales) AS total_store_sales, SUM(returns_amount) AS total_returns, SUM(catalog_sales) + SUM(store_sales) AS total_sales FROM monthly_sales GROUP BY date_sk) SELECT date_sk, total_catalog_sales, total_store_sales, total_sales, total_returns, LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY date_sk) AS prev_total_sales, (total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY date_sk)) / NULLIF(LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY date_sk), 0) AS sales_growth_ratio, LAG(total_returns) OVER (ORDER BY date_sk) AS prev_total_returns, (total_returns - LAG(total_returns) OVER (ORDER BY date_sk)) / NULLIF(LAG(total_returns) OVER (ORDER BY date_sk), 0) AS returns_growth_ratio, CASE WHEN (total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY date_sk)) > 0 THEN 'Increase' WHEN (total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY date_sk)) < 0 THEN 'Decrease' ELSE 'Flat' END AS sales_trend FROM aggregated_monthly ORDER BY date_sk

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT ws_item_sk, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_profit FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_item_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT wr_item_sk, SUM(wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount FROM web_returns GROUP BY wr_item_sk ) SELECT s.ws_item_sk, s.total_sales, s.total_profit, COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount, CASE WHEN s.total_sales > 0 THEN COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) / s.total_sales ELSE 0 END AS return_ratio, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) / NULLIF(s.total_sales,0) > 0.2 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) / NULLIF(s.total_sales,0) > 0.1 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS return_risk, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.ws_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_ship AS ( SELECT ws_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk, AVG(ws_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost_sales, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_ship_mode_sk ), return_ship AS ( SELECT cr_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk, AVG(cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost_returns, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns GROUP BY cr_ship_mode_sk ) SELECT COALESCE(s.ship_mode_sk, r.ship_mode_sk) AS ship_mode_sk, COALESCE(s.sales_cnt,0) AS sales_cnt, COALESCE(r.return_cnt,0) AS return_cnt, COALESCE(s.avg_ship_cost_sales,0) AS avg_ship_cost_sales, COALESCE(r.avg_ship_cost_returns,0) AS avg_ship_cost_returns, (COALESCE(s.avg_ship_cost_sales,0) - COALESCE(r.avg_ship_cost_returns,0)) AS ship_cost_diff, (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) AS net_profit_adj, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) > 50000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) > 20000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_ship s FULL OUTER JOIN return_ship r ON s.ship_mode_sk = r.ship_mode_sk ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10

WITH daily_sales AS ( SELECT ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales_amount, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS daily_sales_profit FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_sold_date_sk ), daily_return_loss AS ( SELECT cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS daily_return_loss FROM catalog_returns GROUP BY cr_returned_date_sk UNION ALL SELECT wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, SUM(wr_net_loss) AS daily_return_loss FROM web_returns GROUP BY wr_returned_date_sk ), aggregated_return_loss AS ( SELECT date_sk, SUM(daily_return_loss) AS total_return_loss FROM daily_return_loss GROUP BY date_sk ) SELECT d.date_sk, COALESCE(d.daily_sales_amount,0) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(d.daily_sales_profit,0) AS sales_profit, COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0) AS total_return_loss, (COALESCE(d.daily_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) AS net_result, SUM(COALESCE(d.daily_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) OVER (ORDER BY d.date_sk) AS running_net_result, AVG(COALESCE(d.daily_sales_profit,0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss,0)) OVER (ORDER BY d.date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_7d_net_result FROM daily_sales d FULL OUTER JOIN aggregated_return_loss r ON d.date_sk = r.date_sk ORDER BY d.date_sk LIMIT 365

WITH purchases AS ( SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, ws_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_purchase_profit FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_item_sk ), catalog_ret AS ( SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, cr_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_loss FROM catalog_returns GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, cr_item_sk ), web_ret AS ( SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, wr_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_web_loss FROM web_returns GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, wr_item_sk ) SELECT sub.customer_sk, sub.item_sk, sub.total_purchase_profit, sub.total_catalog_loss, sub.total_web_loss, sub.total_return_loss, sub.net_loss_per_item, sub.loss_severity, sub.item_rank FROM ( SELECT p.customer_sk, p.item_sk, p.total_purchase_profit, COALESCE(c.total_catalog_loss,0) AS total_catalog_loss, COALESCE(w.total_web_loss,0) AS total_web_loss, (COALESCE(c.total_catalog_loss,0) + COALESCE(w.total_web_loss,0)) AS total_return_loss, (COALESCE(c.total_catalog_loss,0) + COALESCE(w.total_web_loss,0) - p.total_purchase_profit) AS net_loss_per_item, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(c.total_catalog_loss,0) + COALESCE(w.total_web_loss,0) - p.total_purchase_profit) > 1000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN (COALESCE(c.total_catalog_loss,0) + COALESCE(w.total_web_loss,0) - p.total_purchase_profit) > 500 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS loss_severity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_sk ORDER BY (COALESCE(c.total_catalog_loss,0) + COALESCE(w.total_web_loss,0) - p.total_purchase_profit) DESC) AS item_rank FROM purchases p INNER JOIN catalog_ret c ON c.customer_sk = p.customer_sk AND c.item_sk = p.item_sk INNER JOIN web_ret w ON w.customer_sk = p.customer_sk AND w.item_sk = p.item_sk ) sub WHERE sub.net_loss_per_item > 0 AND sub.item_rank <= 3 ORDER BY sub.customer_sk, sub.item_rank

WITH catalog_agg AS ( SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_catalog_net_loss FROM catalog_returns GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk ), web_return_agg AS ( SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(wr_net_loss) AS total_web_net_loss FROM web_returns GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_net_profit FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk ) SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, COALESCE(ca.total_catalog_net_loss,0) AS total_catalog_net_loss, COALESCE(wa.total_web_net_loss,0) AS total_web_net_loss, COALESCE(sa.total_sales_net_profit,0) AS total_sales_net_profit, (COALESCE(ca.total_catalog_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(wa.total_web_net_loss,0)) AS total_return_loss, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(ca.total_catalog_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(wa.total_web_net_loss,0)) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN (COALESCE(ca.total_catalog_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(wa.total_web_net_loss,0)) > 5000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS loss_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(ca.total_catalog_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(wa.total_web_net_loss,0)) DESC) AS loss_rank FROM customer c LEFT JOIN catalog_agg ca ON ca.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk LEFT JOIN web_return_agg wa ON wa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON sa.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE (COALESCE(ca.total_catalog_net_loss,0) + COALESCE(wa.total_web_net_loss,0)) > 0 ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 20

WITH purchase_dates AS ( SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, MIN(ws_sold_date_sk) AS first_purchase_date_sk FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_bill_customer_sk ), cr_return_dates AS ( SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, MAX(cr_returned_date_sk) AS last_cr_return_date_sk FROM catalog_returns GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk ), wr_return_dates AS ( SELECT wr_returning_customer_sk AS customer_sk, MAX(wr_returned_date_sk) AS last_wr_return_date_sk FROM web_returns GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk ), last_return_dates AS ( SELECT COALESCE(cr.customer_sk, wr.customer_sk) AS customer_sk, GREATEST(COALESCE(cr.last_cr_return_date_sk, 0), COALESCE(wr.last_wr_return_date_sk, 0)) AS last_return_date_sk FROM cr_return_dates cr FULL OUTER JOIN wr_return_dates wr ON cr.customer_sk = wr.customer_sk ) SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, pd.first_purchase_date_sk, lr.last_return_date_sk, (lr.last_return_date_sk - pd.first_purchase_date_sk) AS days_between, CASE WHEN lr.last_return_date_sk IS NULL THEN 'NO RETURNS' WHEN (lr.last_return_date_sk - pd.first_purchase_date_sk) > 365 THEN 'INACTIVE' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS activity_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (lr.last_return_date_sk - pd.first_purchase_date_sk) DESC) AS recency_rank FROM customer c LEFT JOIN purchase_dates pd ON pd.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk LEFT JOIN last_return_dates lr ON lr.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE pd.first_purchase_date_sk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY recency_rank LIMIT 50

WITH cc_returns AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage, AVG(sr.sr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax, COUNT(*) AS return_count FROM call_center cc JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN cc.cc_open_date_sk AND cc.cc_closed_date_sk JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, cc.cc_tax_percentage ) SELECT ccr.cc_call_center_id, ccr.cc_name, ccr.cc_city, ccr.cc_state, ccr.cc_tax_percentage, ccr.avg_return_tax, (ccr.cc_tax_percentage - ccr.avg_return_tax) AS tax_diff, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (ccr.cc_tax_percentage - ccr.avg_return_tax) DESC) AS tax_diff_rank, ccr.return_count FROM cc_returns ccr ORDER BY tax_diff_rank

WITH categorized_returns AS ( SELECT sr.sr_ticket_number, sr.sr_return_amt, sr.sr_return_quantity, d.d_date, CASE WHEN sr.sr_return_amt > approx_percentile(sr.sr_return_amt, 0.9) OVER (PARTITION BY d.d_date) THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_amount_category, CASE WHEN sr.sr_return_quantity >= 10 THEN 'Bulk' WHEN sr.sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 4 AND 9 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Small' END AS quantity_category, c.c_preferred_cust_flag FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk ) SELECT cr.d_date, cr.return_amount_category, cr.quantity_category, COUNT(*) AS num_returns, SUM(cr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, AVG(cr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN cr.c_preferred_cust_flag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preferred_cust_returns FROM categorized_returns cr GROUP BY cr.d_date, cr.return_amount_category, cr.quantity_category ORDER BY cr.d_date DESC, cr.return_amount_category

WITH customer_return_counts AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_returns, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_weekend = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS weekend_return_ratio FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) SELECT crc.c_customer_id, crc.c_first_name, crc.c_last_name, crc.weekend_returns, crc.total_returns, crc.weekend_return_ratio, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY crc.weekend_return_ratio DESC) AS weekend_return_rank FROM customer_return_counts crc ORDER BY crc.weekend_return_ratio DESC LIMIT 20

WITH returns_2022 AS ( SELECT sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_amt, sr.sr_return_tax, sr.sr_customer_sk, sr.sr_store_sk FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2022 ), call_center_returns AS ( SELECT cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state, SUM(r.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, AVG(r.sr_return_tax) AS avg_return_tax FROM returns_2022 r JOIN call_center cc ON r.sr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN cc.cc_open_date_sk AND cc.cc_closed_date_sk GROUP BY cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name, cc.cc_city, cc.cc_state ) SELECT ccr.cc_call_center_id, ccr.cc_name, ccr.cc_city, ccr.cc_state, ccr.total_return_amt, ccr.avg_return_tax, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ccr.total_return_amt DESC) AS return_amt_rank, CASE WHEN ccr.total_return_amt > 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN ccr.total_return_amt BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS return_category FROM call_center_returns ccr ORDER BY ccr.total_return_amt DESC

WITH recent_dates AS ( SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_month_seq, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_date >= date_add('month', -12, (SELECT MAX(d_date) FROM date_dim)) ), monthly_returns AS ( SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, sr.sr_returned_date_sk, sr.sr_return_amt, rd.d_year, rd.d_month_seq FROM store_returns sr JOIN recent_dates rd ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = rd.d_date_sk ), store_cc AS ( SELECT mr.sr_store_sk, mr.d_year, mr.d_month_seq, mr.sr_return_amt, cc.cc_call_center_id, cc.cc_name FROM monthly_returns mr JOIN call_center cc ON mr.sr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN cc.cc_open_date_sk AND cc.cc_closed_date_sk ), aggregated AS ( SELECT sc.cc_call_center_id, sc.cc_name, sc.d_year, sc.d_month_seq, SUM(sc.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, AVG(sc.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt FROM store_cc sc GROUP BY sc.cc_call_center_id, sc.cc_name, sc.d_year, sc.d_month_seq ) SELECT a.cc_call_center_id, a.cc_name, a.d_year, a.d_month_seq, a.total_return_amt, a.avg_return_amt, AVG(a.total_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY a.cc_call_center_id ORDER BY a.d_year, a.d_month_seq ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3mo, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_return_amt DESC) AS call_center_return_rank FROM aggregated a ORDER BY a.cc_call_center_id, a.d_year, a.d_month_seq

WITH latest_fy_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_fy_quarter_seq) AS max_fy_quarter_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_fy_year = (SELECT MAX(d_fy_year) FROM date_dim) ), customer_losses AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, d.d_date, sr.sr_net_loss, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_sk ORDER BY d.d_date) AS cumulative_net_loss FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN latest_fy_quarter lfq ON d.d_fy_quarter_seq = lfq.max_fy_quarter_seq JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk ), customer_agg AS ( SELECT cl.c_customer_id, cl.c_first_name, cl.c_last_name, SUM(cl.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, MAX(cl.cumulative_net_loss) AS cumulative_net_loss_to_date FROM customer_losses cl GROUP BY cl.c_customer_id, cl.c_first_name, cl.c_last_name ) SELECT ca.c_customer_id, ca.c_first_name, ca.c_last_name, ca.total_net_loss, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank, CASE WHEN ca.total_net_loss > 5000 THEN 'Very High' WHEN ca.total_net_loss > 1000 THEN 'High' WHEN ca.total_net_loss > 0 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Low' END AS loss_category, ca.cumulative_net_loss_to_date FROM customer_agg ca ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 10

WITH latest_fy_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_fy_quarter_seq) AS max_fy_quarter_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_fy_year = (SELECT MAX(d_fy_year) FROM date_dim) ), customer_losses AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, d.d_month_seq, sr.sr_net_loss FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN latest_fy_quarter lfq ON d.d_fy_quarter_seq = lfq.max_fy_quarter_seq JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE d.d_month_seq >= (SELECT MAX(d_month_seq) - 5 FROM date_dim) ), monthly_agg AS ( SELECT cl.c_customer_id, cl.c_first_name, cl.c_last_name, cl.d_month_seq, SUM(cl.sr_net_loss) AS month_net_loss FROM customer_losses cl GROUP BY cl.c_customer_id, cl.c_first_name, cl.c_last_name, cl.d_month_seq ) SELECT ma.c_customer_id, ma.c_first_name, ma.c_last_name, ma.d_month_seq, ma.month_net_loss, SUM(ma.month_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ma.c_customer_id ORDER BY ma.d_month_seq) AS running_monthly_loss FROM monthly_agg ma ORDER BY ma.c_customer_id, ma.d_month_seq

WITH latest_fy_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_fy_quarter_seq) AS max_fy_quarter_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_fy_year = (SELECT MAX(d_fy_year) FROM date_dim) ), customer_losses AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, d.d_date, sr.sr_net_loss FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN latest_fy_quarter lfq ON d.d_fy_quarter_seq = lfq.max_fy_quarter_seq JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE d.d_day_name = 'Monday' ), customer_agg AS ( SELECT cl.c_customer_id, cl.c_first_name, cl.c_last_name, AVG(cl.sr_net_loss) AS avg_monday_loss, COUNT(*) AS monday_return_cnt FROM customer_losses cl GROUP BY cl.c_customer_id, cl.c_first_name, cl.c_last_name ) SELECT ca.c_customer_id, ca.c_first_name, ca.c_last_name, ca.avg_monday_loss, ca.monday_return_cnt, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY ca.avg_monday_loss DESC) AS loss_quartile FROM customer_agg ca ORDER BY ca.avg_monday_loss DESC LIMIT 15

WITH latest_fy_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_fy_quarter_seq) AS max_fy_quarter_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_fy_year = (SELECT MAX(d_fy_year) FROM date_dim) ), customer_losses AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, d.d_date, sr.sr_net_loss, CASE WHEN sr.sr_fee > 0 THEN 'Fee' ELSE 'NoFee' END AS fee_flag FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN latest_fy_quarter lfq ON d.d_fy_quarter_seq = lfq.max_fy_quarter_seq JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk ), customer_agg AS ( SELECT cl.c_customer_id, cl.c_first_name, cl.c_last_name, SUM(cl.sr_net_loss) AS total_loss, COUNT(CASE WHEN cl.fee_flag = 'Fee' THEN 1 END) AS fee_return_cnt FROM customer_losses cl GROUP BY cl.c_customer_id, cl.c_first_name, cl.c_last_name ) SELECT ca.c_customer_id, ca.c_first_name, ca.c_last_name, ca.total_loss, ca.fee_return_cnt, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_loss DESC) AS loss_percentile FROM customer_agg ca WHERE ca.fee_return_cnt > 0 ORDER BY ca.total_loss DESC LIMIT 20

WITH latest_fy_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_fy_quarter_seq) AS max_fy_quarter_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_fy_year = (SELECT MAX(d_fy_year) FROM date_dim) ), customer_losses AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, d.d_date, sr.sr_net_loss, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_customer_sk ORDER BY d.d_date DESC) AS rn FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN latest_fy_quarter lfq ON d.d_fy_quarter_seq = lfq.max_fy_quarter_seq JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk WHERE sr.sr_net_loss > 0 ), customer_agg AS ( SELECT cl.c_customer_id, cl.c_first_name, cl.c_last_name, SUM(cl.sr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, MIN(cl.d_date) AS first_loss_date FROM customer_losses cl WHERE cl.rn <= 3 GROUP BY cl.c_customer_id, cl.c_first_name, cl.c_last_name ) SELECT ca.c_customer_id, ca.c_first_name, ca.c_last_name, ca.total_net_loss, ca.first_loss_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM customer_agg ca ORDER BY ca.total_net_loss DESC LIMIT 5

WITH latest_fy_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_fy_quarter_seq) AS max_fy_quarter_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_fy_year = (SELECT MAX(d_fy_year) FROM date_dim) ), customer_losses AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, d.d_date, sr.sr_net_loss, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.d_date) AS loss_year FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN latest_fy_quarter lfq ON d.d_fy_quarter_seq = lfq.max_fy_quarter_seq JOIN customer c ON sr.sr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk ), yearly_agg AS ( SELECT cl.c_customer_id, cl.c_first_name, cl.c_last_name, cl.loss_year, SUM(cl.sr_net_loss) AS yearly_loss FROM customer_losses cl GROUP BY cl.c_customer_id, cl.c_first_name, cl.c_last_name, cl.loss_year ) SELECT ya.c_customer_id, ya.c_first_name, ya.c_last_name, ya.loss_year, ya.yearly_loss, LAG(ya.yearly_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY ya.c_customer_id ORDER BY ya.loss_year) AS prior_year_loss FROM yearly_agg ya WHERE ya.loss_year >= (SELECT MAX(loss_year) - 2 FROM yearly_agg) ORDER BY ya.c_customer_id, ya.loss_year DESC

/* Variant 5: Add a percentile calculation for net profit adjustment */
WITH sales_ship AS (
    SELECT ws_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
           COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_ship_mode_sk
),
return_ship AS (
    SELECT cr_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
           SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
           COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM catalog_returns
    GROUP BY cr_ship_mode_sk
),
joined AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(s.ship_mode_sk, r.ship_mode_sk) AS ship_mode_sk,
           COALESCE(s.sales_cnt, 0) AS sales_cnt,
           COALESCE(r.return_cnt, 0) AS return_cnt,
           (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_profit_adj
    FROM sales_ship s
    FULL OUTER JOIN return_ship r ON s.ship_mode_sk = r.ship_mode_sk
)
SELECT ship_mode_sk,
       sales_cnt,
       return_cnt,
       net_profit_adj,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_profit_adj DESC) AS profit_percentile,
       NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY net_profit_adj DESC) AS profit_quartile
FROM joined
ORDER BY profit_percentile
LIMIT 20

/* Variant 6: Pivot ship mode profits into columns using conditional aggregation */
WITH sales_ship AS (
    SELECT ws_ship_mode_sk,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_ship_mode_sk
),
return_ship AS (
    SELECT cr_ship_mode_sk,
           SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss
    FROM catalog_returns
    GROUP BY cr_ship_mode_sk
),
joined AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(s.ws_ship_mode_sk, r.cr_ship_mode_sk) AS ship_mode_sk,
           COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) AS total_sales_profit,
           COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss
    FROM sales_ship s
    FULL OUTER JOIN return_ship r ON s.ws_ship_mode_sk = r.cr_ship_mode_sk
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN ship_mode_sk = 1 THEN total_sales_profit - total_return_loss END) AS mode_1_profit_adj,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ship_mode_sk = 2 THEN total_sales_profit - total_return_loss END) AS mode_2_profit_adj,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ship_mode_sk = 3 THEN total_sales_profit - total_return_loss END) AS mode_3_profit_adj,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ship_mode_sk = 4 THEN total_sales_profit - total_return_loss END) AS mode_4_profit_adj
FROM joined

/* Variant 2: Add a windowed running total of profit and order by ship mode */
WITH sales_ship AS (
    SELECT ws_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
           AVG(ws_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost_sales,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
           COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_ship_mode_sk
),
return_ship AS (
    SELECT cr_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
           AVG(cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost_returns,
           SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
           COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM catalog_returns
    GROUP BY cr_ship_mode_sk
)
SELECT COALESCE(s.ship_mode_sk, r.ship_mode_sk) AS ship_mode_sk,
       COALESCE(s.sales_cnt, 0) AS sales_cnt,
       COALESCE(r.return_cnt, 0) AS return_cnt,
       COALESCE(s.avg_ship_cost_sales, 0) AS avg_ship_cost_sales,
       COALESCE(r.avg_ship_cost_returns, 0) AS avg_ship_cost_returns,
       (COALESCE(s.avg_ship_cost_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.avg_ship_cost_returns, 0)) AS ship_cost_diff,
       (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_profit_adj,
       SUM(COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(s.ship_mode_sk, r.ship_mode_sk) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_profit_adj
FROM sales_ship s
FULL OUTER JOIN return_ship r ON s.ship_mode_sk = r.ship_mode_sk
ORDER BY ship_mode_sk

/* Variant 4: Use a HAVING clause to keep only ship modes with profit rank > 5 and add ORDER BY total counts */
WITH sales_ship AS (
    SELECT ws_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
           AVG(ws_ext_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost_sales,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit,
           COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt
    FROM web_sales
    GROUP BY ws_ship_mode_sk
),
return_ship AS (
    SELECT cr_ship_mode_sk AS ship_mode_sk,
           AVG(cr_return_ship_cost) AS avg_ship_cost_returns,
           SUM(cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss,
           COUNT(*) AS return_cnt
    FROM catalog_returns
    GROUP BY cr_ship_mode_sk
),
joined AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(s.ship_mode_sk, r.ship_mode_sk) AS ship_mode_sk,
           COALESCE(s.sales_cnt, 0) AS sales_cnt,
           COALESCE(r.return_cnt, 0) AS return_cnt,
           COALESCE(s.avg_ship_cost_sales, 0) AS avg_ship_cost_sales,
           COALESCE(r.avg_ship_cost_returns, 0) AS avg_ship_cost_returns,
           (COALESCE(s.avg_ship_cost_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.avg_ship_cost_returns, 0)) AS ship_cost_diff,
           (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) AS net_profit_adj,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) DESC) AS profit_rank
    FROM sales_ship s
    FULL OUTER JOIN return_ship r ON s.ship_mode_sk = r.ship_mode_sk
)
SELECT *
FROM joined
WHERE profit_rank > 5
ORDER BY (sales_cnt + return_cnt) DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH tax_by_state AS ( SELECT s.s_state, SUM(sr.sr_return_tax) AS total_tax, AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS return_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ca.ca_country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS domestic_return_cnt FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE d.d_weekend = 'Y' GROUP BY s.s_state ) SELECT s_state, total_tax, avg_return_amt, return_count, ROUND(100.0 * domestic_return_cnt / NULLIF(return_count, 0), 2) AS domestic_return_pct, CASE WHEN total_tax > 50000 THEN 'High Tax' ELSE 'Normal Tax' END AS tax_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_tax DESC) AS tax_rank FROM tax_by_state ORDER BY tax_rank LIMIT 10

WITH latest_quarter AS ( SELECT MAX(d_fy_quarter_seq) AS max_quarter FROM date_dim ), reason_address_agg AS ( SELECT sr.sr_reason_sk, ca.ca_address_id, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_country, s.s_store_name, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN latest_quarter lq ON d.d_fy_quarter_seq = lq.max_quarter JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk GROUP BY sr.sr_reason_sk, ca.ca_address_id, ca.ca_city, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_country, s.s_store_name ), ranked_addresses AS ( SELECT sr_reason_sk, ca_address_id, ca_city, ca_state, ca_country, s_store_name, total_return_qty, CASE WHEN ca_country = 'USA' THEN 'Domestic' ELSE 'International' END AS address_type, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sr_reason_sk ORDER BY total_return_qty DESC) AS qty_rank FROM reason_address_agg ) SELECT sr_reason_sk, ca_address_id, ca_city, ca_state, ca_country, s_store_name, total_return_qty, address_type, qty_rank FROM ranked_addresses WHERE qty_rank <= 5 ORDER BY sr_reason_sk, qty_rank

WITH store_agg AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, s.s_country, s.s_closed_date_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(CASE WHEN ca.ca_country = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS domestic_returns FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN date_dim d_ret ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk WHERE d_ret.d_fy_year = 2023 GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, s.s_country, s.s_closed_date_sk ) SELECT s_store_id, s_store_name, s_city, s_state, s_country, total_return_amt, total_returns, domestic_returns, CASE WHEN s_closed_date_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 'Closed' ELSE 'Open' END AS store_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS store_return_rank FROM store_agg ORDER BY store_return_rank LIMIT 10

WITH monthly_loss AS ( SELECT s.s_state AS state, s.s_city AS city, d.d_year AS year, d.d_month_seq AS month_seq, SUM(sr.sr_net_loss) AS month_net_loss, SUM(CASE WHEN ca.ca_country = 'USA' THEN sr.sr_net_loss ELSE 0 END) AS domestic_net_loss, SUM(CASE WHEN ca.ca_country <> 'USA' THEN sr.sr_net_loss ELSE 0 END) AS international_net_loss FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk GROUP BY s.s_state, s.s_city, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ) SELECT state, city, year, month_seq, month_net_loss, domestic_net_loss, international_net_loss, CASE WHEN month_net_loss < 1000 THEN 'Low' WHEN month_net_loss < 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS loss_category, LAG(month_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY state, city ORDER BY year, month_seq) AS prev_month_net_loss, ROUND(100.0 * (month_net_loss - LAG(month_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY state, city ORDER BY year, month_seq)) / NULLIF(LAG(month_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY state, city ORDER BY year, month_seq), 0), 2) AS pct_change FROM monthly_loss ORDER BY state, city, year, month_seq

WITH store_agg AS ( SELECT sr.sr_store_sk, AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, AVG(CASE WHEN ca.ca_country = 'USA' THEN sr.sr_return_amt END) AS domestic_avg_return, AVG(CASE WHEN ca.ca_country <> 'USA' THEN sr.sr_return_amt END) AS international_avg_return FROM store_returns sr JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_fy_year = 2023 GROUP BY sr.sr_store_sk ), overall_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(sr_return_amt) AS overall_avg_return FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_fy_year = 2023 ) SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, sa.avg_return_amt, sa.total_returns, sa.domestic_avg_return, sa.international_avg_return, oa.overall_avg_return, CASE WHEN sa.avg_return_amt > oa.overall_avg_return THEN 'Above Avg' ELSE 'Below Avg' END AS performance_flag, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.avg_return_amt DESC) AS avg_return_rank FROM store_agg sa JOIN store s ON sa.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY avg_return_rank LIMIT 20

WITH cumulative AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, d.d_date, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_store_sk ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_total, SUM(CASE WHEN ca.ca_country = 'USA' THEN sr.sr_return_amt END) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_store_sk ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_domestic, SUM(CASE WHEN ca.ca_country <> 'USA' THEN sr.sr_return_amt END) OVER (PARTITION BY sr.sr_store_sk ORDER BY d.d_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_international FROM store_returns sr JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN customer_address ca ON sr.sr_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk ), first_cross AS ( SELECT s_store_id, MIN(d_date) AS first_cross_date FROM cumulative WHERE cumulative_total > 100000 GROUP BY s_store_id ) SELECT c.s_store_id, c.s_store_name, c.d_date, c.cumulative_total, c.cumulative_domestic, c.cumulative_international, CASE WHEN c.cumulative_total > 100000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS risk_flag, fc.first_cross_date FROM cumulative c LEFT JOIN first_cross fc ON c.s_store_id = fc.s_store_id ORDER BY c.s_store_id, c.d_date

SELECT
  i.i_class,
  cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
  SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit,
  AVG(SUM(cs.cs_net_profit)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY i.i_class
    ORDER BY cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS three_day_moving_avg_profit,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 10000 THEN 'High'
    WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0 THEN 'Positive'
    ELSE 'Negative'
  END AS profit_category,
  MAX(p.p_discount_active) AS discount_active_flag
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
GROUP BY i.i_class, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
ORDER BY i.i_class, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  i.i_item_id,
  i.i_brand,
  i.i_category,
  SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
  SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
  SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'Very High'
    WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 20000 THEN 'High'
    WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 5000 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS profit_bracket,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV'
      WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email'
      WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END
  ) AS primary_promo_channel
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_brand, i.i_category
HAVING SUM(cs.cs_quantity) > 0
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS bill_customer_id,
  SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
  SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount_amount,
  AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_per_sale,
  COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tv_promo_transactions,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) AS pct_tv_promo,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_category) AS distinct_categories_purchased,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 100000 THEN 'Platinum'
    WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 50000 THEN 'Gold'
    WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 20000 THEN 'Silver'
    ELSE 'Bronze'
  END AS customer_tier,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM catalog_sales cs
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT
  i.i_item_id,
  cs.cs_warehouse_sk AS warehouse_id,
  SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS total_sold_quantity,
  AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_inventory_on_hand,
  CASE
    WHEN AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE SUM(cs.cs_quantity) / AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand)
  END AS turnover_ratio,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (
    PARTITION BY i.i_item_id
    ORDER BY
      CASE
        WHEN AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE SUM(cs.cs_quantity) / AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand)
      END DESC
  ) AS turnover_rank,
  MAX(p.p_promo_name) AS any_promo_name
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN inventory inv
  ON inv.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, cs.cs_warehouse_sk
HAVING SUM(cs.cs_quantity) > 0
ORDER BY turnover_ratio DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT
  p.p_promo_sk,
  p.p_promo_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cs.cs_item_sk) AS distinct_items,
  SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
  SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount_amount,
  AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_per_sale,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) / SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt)
  END AS profit_to_discount_ratio,
  CASE
    WHEN p.p_cost > SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) THEN 'Costly'
    ELSE 'Profitable'
  END AS promotion_cost_status,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) / SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt)
      END DESC
  ) AS profitability_rank,
  AVG(i.i_current_price) AS avg_item_current_price
FROM promotion p
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY p.p_promo_sk, p.p_promo_name, p.p_cost
HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 0
ORDER BY profit_to_discount_ratio DESC
LIMIT 30

WITH daily_sales AS (
  SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date,
    SUM(cs.cs_quantity) AS qty_sold,
    MAX(p.p_promo_name) AS promo_name,
    AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_on_hand
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  LEFT JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    AND inv.inv_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
  GROUP BY i.i_item_id, cs.cs_sold_date_sk
),
sales_lags AS (
  SELECT
    ds.i_item_id,
    ds.sold_date,
    ds.qty_sold,
    ds.promo_name,
    ds.avg_on_hand,
    LAG(ds.qty_sold, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.i_item_id ORDER BY ds.sold_date) AS qty_lag1,
    LAG(ds.qty_sold, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.i_item_id ORDER BY ds.sold_date) AS qty_lag2,
    LAG(ds.qty_sold, 3) OVER (PARTITION BY ds.i_item_id ORDER BY ds.sold_date) AS qty_lag3
  FROM daily_sales ds
)
SELECT
  sl.i_item_id,
  sl.sold_date,
  sl.qty_sold,
  sl.promo_name,
  sl.avg_on_hand,
  CASE
    WHEN sl.qty_lag1 IS NOT NULL AND sl.qty_lag2 IS NOT NULL AND sl.qty_lag3 IS NOT NULL
         AND sl.qty_sold < sl.qty_lag1
         AND sl.qty_lag1 < sl.qty_lag2
         AND sl.qty_lag2 < sl.qty_lag3
    THEN 'Decreasing Trend'
    ELSE 'Stable/Increasing'
  END AS sales_trend
FROM sales_lags sl
WHERE sl.qty_lag1 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sl.i_item_id, sl.sold_date
LIMIT 100

WITH weekly_page_metrics AS (SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_url, d_access.d_year, d_access.d_week_seq, wp.wp_link_count, LAG(wp.wp_link_count) OVER (PARTITION BY wp.wp_web_page_sk ORDER BY d_access.d_year, d_access.d_week_seq) AS prev_week_link_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_access.d_year, d_access.d_week_seq ORDER BY wp.wp_link_count DESC) AS rank_in_week FROM web_page wp JOIN date_dim d_access ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d_access.d_date_sk) SELECT wp_web_page_sk, wp_url, d_year, d_week_seq, wp_link_count, prev_week_link_count, CASE WHEN prev_week_link_count IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN wp_link_count > prev_week_link_count THEN 'Increase' WHEN wp_link_count < prev_week_link_count THEN 'Decrease' ELSE 'No Change' END AS link_change, (wp_link_count - COALESCE(prev_week_link_count, 0)) AS link_change_amount FROM weekly_page_metrics WHERE rank_in_week <= 5 ORDER BY d_year, d_week_seq, rank_in_week LIMIT 100

WITH dept_month_active AS (SELECT cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk) AS active_pages FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d ON cp.cp_start_date_sk <= d.d_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk >= d.d_date_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_department, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq) SELECT cp_department, d_year, d_month_seq, active_pages, CASE WHEN active_pages >= 100 THEN 'High' WHEN active_pages >= 50 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS activity_level, SUM(active_pages) OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY d_year, d_month_seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_active_pages, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY active_pages DESC) AS month_rank_by_active_pages FROM dept_month_active ORDER BY cp_department, d_year, d_month_seq LIMIT 200

SELECT cp.cp_type, wp.wp_type, d_start.d_day_name, COUNT(*) AS pair_count, AVG(wp.wp_char_count) AS avg_char_count, SUM(wp.wp_link_count) AS total_link_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 100 THEN 'Strong' ELSE 'Weak' END AS pair_strength, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS pair_rank FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN web_page wp ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = wp.wp_creation_date_sk GROUP BY cp.cp_type, wp.wp_type, d_start.d_day_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY pair_count DESC LIMIT 50

WITH daily_counts AS (SELECT d.d_date, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk) AS active_catalog_pages, COUNT(wp.wp_web_page_sk) AS web_page_accesses FROM date_dim d LEFT JOIN catalog_page cp ON cp.cp_start_date_sk <= d.d_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk >= d.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN web_page wp ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date) SELECT d_date, active_catalog_pages, web_page_accesses, CASE WHEN active_catalog_pages = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(web_page_accesses AS DOUBLE) / active_catalog_pages END AS accesses_per_active_page, AVG(CASE WHEN active_catalog_pages = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(web_page_accesses AS DOUBLE) / active_catalog_pages END) OVER (ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_accesses_per_page_7d FROM daily_counts WHERE d_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' ORDER BY d_date LIMIT 200

SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, ws.web_site_id, cp.cp_department, d_start.d_date AS page_start_date, d_end.d_date AS page_end_date, d_open.d_date AS site_open_date, d_close.d_date AS site_close_date, GREATEST(d_start.d_date, d_open.d_date) AS overlap_start, LEAST(d_end.d_date, d_close.d_date) AS overlap_end, CASE WHEN date_diff('day', GREATEST(d_start.d_date, d_open.d_date), LEAST(d_end.d_date, d_close.d_date)) + 1 < 30 THEN 'Short' WHEN date_diff('day', GREATEST(d_start.d_date, d_open.d_date), LEAST(d_end.d_date, d_close.d_date)) + 1 BETWEEN 30 AND 180 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Long' END AS overlap_category, date_diff('day', GREATEST(d_start.d_date, d_open.d_date), LEAST(d_end.d_date, d_close.d_date)) + 1 AS overlap_days, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.cp_department ORDER BY date_diff('day', GREATEST(d_start.d_date, d_open.d_date), LEAST(d_end.d_date, d_close.d_date)) + 1 DESC) AS dept_overlap_rank FROM catalog_page cp JOIN date_dim d_start ON cp.cp_start_date_sk = d_start.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_end ON cp.cp_end_date_sk = d_end.d_date_sk JOIN web_site ws ON cp.cp_start_date_sk <= ws.web_close_date_sk AND cp.cp_end_date_sk >= ws.web_open_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk WHERE GREATEST(d_start.d_date, d_open.d_date) <= LEAST(d_end.d_date, d_close.d_date) AND cp.cp_department IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cp.cp_department, dept_overlap_rank LIMIT 100

WITH page_with_date AS (SELECT wp.wp_web_page_sk, wp.wp_link_count, wp.wp_image_count, d_create.d_date AS creation_date FROM web_page wp JOIN date_dim d_create ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = d_create.d_date_sk), site_page_stats AS (SELECT ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, d_open.d_date AS open_date, d_close.d_date AS close_date, COUNT(DISTINCT pw.wp_web_page_sk) AS pages_created, AVG(pw.wp_link_count) AS avg_link_count, AVG(pw.wp_image_count) AS avg_image_count FROM web_site ws JOIN date_dim d_open ON ws.web_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim d_close ON ws.web_close_date_sk = d_close.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN page_with_date pw ON pw.creation_date BETWEEN d_open.d_date AND d_close.d_date GROUP BY ws.web_site_id, ws.web_name, ws.web_state, d_open.d_date, d_close.d_date) SELECT web_site_id, web_name, web_state, pages_created, avg_link_count, avg_image_count, CASE WHEN CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN open_date AND close_date THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Closed' END AS site_status, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_link_count DESC) AS link_count_rank FROM site_page_stats WHERE pages_created > 0 ORDER BY link_count_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_sold_qty FROM store_sales ss WHERE ss.ss_sold_date_sk >= 20220101 GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM store_returns sr WHERE sr.sr_returned_date_sk >= 20220101 GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk) SELECT i.i_category, COUNT(*) AS item_count, SUM(sa.total_sold_qty) AS cat_total_sold, SUM(ra.total_return_qty) AS cat_total_return, (SUM(ra.total_return_qty) * 1.0) / NULLIF(SUM(sa.total_sold_qty),0) AS cat_return_rate FROM item i LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON i.i_item_sk = sa.ss_item_sk LEFT JOIN returns_agg ra ON i.i_item_sk = ra.sr_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_category HAVING SUM(sa.total_sold_qty) > 0 ORDER BY cat_return_rate DESC LIMIT 20

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_sold_qty FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM store_returns sr GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk) SELECT i.i_category, i.i_item_id, sa.total_sold_qty, ra.total_return_qty, (ra.total_return_qty * 1.0) / NULLIF(sa.total_sold_qty,0) AS return_rate, LAG((ra.total_return_qty * 1.0) / NULLIF(sa.total_sold_qty,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category ORDER BY i.i_item_id) AS prev_return_rate FROM item i LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON i.i_item_sk = sa.ss_item_sk LEFT JOIN returns_agg ra ON i.i_item_sk = ra.sr_item_sk WHERE sa.total_sold_qty IS NOT NULL AND i.i_category = 'Sports' ORDER BY return_rate DESC LIMIT 10

WITH sales_agg AS (SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_sold_qty FROM store_sales ss WHERE ss.ss_quantity > 0 GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk), returns_agg AS (SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM store_returns sr WHERE sr.sr_return_quantity > 0 GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk) SELECT i.i_category, i.i_item_id, COALESCE(sa.total_sold_qty,0) AS sold_qty, COALESCE(ra.total_return_qty,0) AS return_qty, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sa.total_sold_qty,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (ra.total_return_qty * 1.0) / sa.total_sold_qty END AS return_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN (ra.total_return_qty * 1.0) / NULLIF(sa.total_sold_qty,0) > 0.2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category) AS high_return_items_in_cat FROM item i LEFT JOIN sales_agg sa ON i.i_item_sk = sa.ss_item_sk LEFT JOIN returns_agg ra ON i.i_item_sk = ra.sr_item_sk ORDER BY i.i_category, return_rate DESC LIMIT 40

WITH store_agg AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, s.s_country, s.s_closed_date_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN date_dim d_ret ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk WHERE d_ret.d_day_name = 'Monday' AND sr.sr_return_amt > 0 GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, s.s_country, s.s_closed_date_sk ) SELECT s_store_id, s_store_name, s_city, s_state, s_country, total_return_amt, total_returns, total_quantity, CASE WHEN s_closed_date_sk IS NULL THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END AS store_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS quantity_rank FROM store_agg ORDER BY quantity_rank LIMIT 8

WITH store_agg AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, s.s_country, s.s_closed_date_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS total_returns, SUM(sr.sr_return_tax) AS total_tax FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN date_dim d_ret ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk WHERE d_ret.d_current_quarter = 'Q2' AND sr.sr_return_amt BETWEEN 10 AND 500 GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, s.s_country, s.s_closed_date_sk ) SELECT s_store_id, s_store_name, s_city, s_state, s_country, total_return_amt, total_returns, total_tax, CASE WHEN s_closed_date_sk IS NULL THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END AS store_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s_state ORDER BY total_tax DESC) AS state_tax_rank FROM store_agg ORDER BY total_tax DESC LIMIT 9

WITH store_agg AS ( SELECT s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, s.s_country, s.s_closed_date_sk, SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, COUNT(sr.sr_ticket_number) AS total_tickets, AVG(sr.sr_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt FROM store_returns sr JOIN store s ON sr.sr_store_sk = s.s_store_sk JOIN date_dim d_ret ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d_ret.d_date_sk WHERE d_ret.d_month_seq BETWEEN 202301 AND 202312 AND s.s_state = 'CA' GROUP BY s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, s.s_city, s.s_state, s.s_country, s.s_closed_date_sk ) SELECT s_store_id, s_store_name, s_city, s_state, s_country, total_return_amt, total_tickets, avg_return_amt, CASE WHEN s_closed_date_sk IS NULL THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END AS store_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_country ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC) AS country_store_rank FROM store_agg ORDER BY total_return_amt DESC LIMIT 10

WITH daily_store_profit AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS daily_net_profit, SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_ext_discount_amt > 0 THEN ss.ss_ext_discount_amt ELSE 0 END) AS daily_discount_total, SUM(CASE WHEN ss.ss_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo_txn_count FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk ) SELECT dsp.ss_store_sk, dsp.ss_sold_date_sk, dsp.daily_net_profit, dsp.daily_discount_total, dsp.promo_txn_count, SUM(dsp.daily_net_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY dsp.ss_store_sk ORDER BY dsp.ss_sold_date_sk ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_profit, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dsp.ss_store_sk ORDER BY dsp.daily_net_profit DESC) AS daily_profit_rank FROM daily_store_profit dsp WHERE dsp.daily_net_profit > 0 ORDER BY dsp.ss_store_sk, dsp.ss_sold_date_sk

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT sp.ss_store_sk, sp.cd_gender, sp.cd_credit_rating, sp.total_net_profit, sp.total_sales, sp.sales_transactions, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.cd_gender ORDER BY sp.total_net_profit DESC) AS gender_store_rank FROM ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_credit_rating, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS sales_transactions FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_credit_rating ) sp WHERE sp.total_sales > 10000 ) ranked WHERE ranked.gender_store_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ranked.cd_gender, ranked.gender_store_rank

WITH sales_by_demo AS ( SELECT ss.ss_cdemo_sk AS cd_demo_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_cdemo_sk ), returns_by_demo AS ( SELECT wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk AS cd_demo_sk, SUM(wr.wr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM web_returns wr GROUP BY wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk ) SELECT s.cd_demo_sk, s.total_sales, r.total_return_loss, CASE WHEN s.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE r.total_return_loss / s.total_sales END AS loss_ratio, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.total_sales = 0 THEN 0 ELSE r.total_return_loss / s.total_sales END DESC) AS loss_ratio_rank FROM sales_by_demo s JOIN returns_by_demo r ON s.cd_demo_sk = r.cd_demo_sk WHERE s.total_sales > 0 ORDER BY loss_ratio_rank LIMIT 5

WITH bucket_stats AS ( SELECT hd.hd_vehicle_count, CASE WHEN cd.cd_purchase_estimate < 1000 THEN 'Low' WHEN cd.cd_purchase_estimate BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS purchase_estimate_bucket, AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_ext, COUNT(*) AS transaction_cnt FROM store_sales ss JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY hd.hd_vehicle_count, CASE WHEN cd.cd_purchase_estimate < 1000 THEN 'Low' WHEN cd.cd_purchase_estimate BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT bs.hd_vehicle_count, bs.purchase_estimate_bucket, bs.avg_sales_price, bs.total_sales_ext, bs.transaction_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bs.purchase_estimate_bucket ORDER BY bs.avg_sales_price DESC) AS price_rank_within_bucket FROM bucket_stats bs ) ranked WHERE ranked.price_rank_within_bucket <= 3 ORDER BY ranked.purchase_estimate_bucket, ranked.avg_sales_price DESC

SELECT wr.wr_order_number, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_credit_rating, ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sales_price, wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax, CASE WHEN ss.ss_sales_price = 0 THEN NULL ELSE wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax / ss.ss_sales_price END AS return_to_sale_ratio, CASE WHEN ss.ss_sales_price > 0 AND wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax / ss.ss_sales_price > 1.5 THEN 'Potential Fraud' ELSE 'Normal' END AS return_flag, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN ss.ss_sales_price > 0 THEN wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax / ss.ss_sales_price ELSE 0 END DESC) AS ratio_rank FROM web_returns wr JOIN store_sales ss ON wr.wr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND wr.wr_returned_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk JOIN customer_demographics cd ON wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk WHERE wr.wr_return_amt_inc_tax > 0 ORDER BY ratio_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_demo AS ( SELECT ss.ss_cdemo_sk AS demo_key, AVG(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_qty_sold, AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_cdemo_sk ), returns_demo AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk AS demo_key, AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, AVG(td.t_hour) AS avg_return_hour, MIN(td.t_shift) AS return_shift, MIN(cp.cp_department) AS department FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_cdemo_sk ) SELECT sd.demo_key, sd.avg_discount, rd.avg_return_qty, rd.avg_return_hour, rd.return_shift, rd.department, CASE WHEN rd.avg_return_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE rd.avg_return_qty / NULLIF(sd.avg_discount, 0) END AS return_to_discount_ratio, CASE WHEN rd.avg_return_qty / NULLIF(sd.avg_discount, 0) > 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS ratio_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN rd.avg_return_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE rd.avg_return_qty / NULLIF(sd.avg_discount, 0) END DESC) AS ratio_rank FROM sales_demo sd LEFT JOIN returns_demo rd ON sd.demo_key = rd.demo_key ORDER BY ratio_rank

WITH sales_promo_shift AS ( SELECT ss.ss_promo_sk, td.t_shift, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_sales_qty, AVG(td.t_hour) AS avg_sale_hour FROM store_sales ss JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk, td.t_shift ), returns_with_promo AS ( SELECT ss.ss_promo_sk, td.t_shift, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, AVG(td.t_hour) AS avg_return_hour, MIN(cp.cp_department) AS return_department FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN store_sales ss ON cr.cr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_promo_sk, td.t_shift ) SELECT COALESCE(s.t_shift, r.t_shift) AS shift, COALESCE(s.ss_promo_sk, r.ss_promo_sk) AS promo_sk, COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) AS total_sales_profit, COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss, COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS net_effect, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) > 0 THEN 'PROFIT' ELSE 'LOSS' END AS net_effect_category, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(s.t_shift, r.t_shift) ORDER BY COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) DESC) AS promo_rank, COALESCE(r.return_department, 'UNKNOWN') AS return_department, COALESCE(s.avg_sale_hour, r.avg_return_hour) AS representative_hour FROM sales_promo_shift s FULL OUTER JOIN returns_with_promo r ON s.ss_promo_sk = r.ss_promo_sk AND s.t_shift = r.t_shift ORDER BY shift, promo_rank

WITH sales_daily AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS daily_sales_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS daily_sales_amount, AVG(td.t_hour) AS avg_sold_hour FROM store_sales ss JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk ), returns_daily AS ( SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS daily_return_loss, MIN(cp.cp_department) AS return_department FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN store_sales ss ON cr.cr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND cr.cr_returned_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk ), combined_daily AS ( SELECT s.ss_store_sk AS store_sk, s.ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, s.daily_sales_profit, COALESCE(r.daily_return_loss, 0) AS daily_return_loss, s.avg_sold_hour, r.return_department, s.daily_sales_profit - COALESCE(r.daily_return_loss, 0) AS net_daily_profit FROM sales_daily s LEFT JOIN returns_daily r ON s.ss_store_sk = r.ss_store_sk AND s.ss_sold_date_sk = r.ss_sold_date_sk ) SELECT store_sk, date_sk, net_daily_profit, AVG(net_daily_profit) OVER ( PARTITION BY store_sk ORDER BY date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_7d, CASE WHEN net_daily_profit < 0 THEN 'NEGATIVE' ELSE 'POSITIVE' END AS daily_status, CASE WHEN AVG(net_daily_profit) OVER ( PARTITION BY store_sk ORDER BY date_sk ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) > 0 THEN 'PROFITING_TREND' ELSE 'DECLINING_TREND' END AS trend_indicator, return_department FROM combined_daily ORDER BY store_sk, date_sk

WITH sales_by_shift_hour AS ( SELECT td.t_shift, td.t_hour, SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) AS total_sales_profit, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales_amount, COUNT(*) AS sales_transactions FROM store_sales ss JOIN time_dim td ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY td.t_shift, td.t_hour ), returns_by_shift_hour AS ( SELECT td.t_shift, td.t_hour, MIN(cp.cp_department) AS department, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_return_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(*) AS return_transactions FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk JOIN catalog_page cp ON cr.cr_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY td.t_shift, td.t_hour ) SELECT COALESCE(s.t_shift, r.t_shift) AS shift, COALESCE(s.t_hour, r.t_hour) AS hour, COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) AS total_sales_profit, COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS total_return_loss, COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) AS net_effect, SUM(COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(s.t_shift, r.t_shift) ORDER BY COALESCE(s.t_hour, r.t_hour) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_effect, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) < 0 THEN 'LOSS' ELSE 'PROFIT' END AS hour_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(s.t_shift, r.t_shift) ORDER BY COALESCE(s.total_sales_profit, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_return_loss, 0) DESC) AS hour_rank FROM sales_by_shift_hour s FULL OUTER JOIN returns_by_shift_hour r ON s.t_shift = r.t_shift AND s.t_hour = r.t_hour ORDER BY shift, hour

WITH sales_per_item AS ( SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sold_qty, SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sold_amount FROM store_sales ss GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk ), returns_per_item AS ( SELECT cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_catalog_page_sk, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS returned_qty, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS returned_amount, AVG(td.t_hour) AS avg_return_hour FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk, cr.cr_catalog_page_sk ), combined AS ( SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_sk, cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_type, sp.sold_qty, rp.returned_qty, CASE WHEN sp.sold_qty = 0 THEN 0 ELSE rp.returned_qty / sp.sold_qty END AS return_rate, rp.avg_return_hour FROM catalog_page cp LEFT JOIN returns_per_item rp ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = rp.cr_catalog_page_sk LEFT JOIN sales_per_item sp ON rp.cr_item_sk = sp.ss_item_sk ) SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, cp_department, cp_type, COALESCE(sold_qty, 0) AS total_sold_qty, COALESCE(returned_qty, 0) AS total_returned_qty, return_rate, CASE WHEN return_rate > 0.5 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN return_rate > 0.2 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS return_rate_category, avg_return_hour, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cp_department ORDER BY return_rate DESC) AS dept_return_rate_rank FROM combined WHERE cp_department IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cp_department, dept_return_rate_rank

WITH returns_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_catalog_page_sk, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.cr_returned_date_sk) AS return_days, AVG(td.t_hour) AS avg_return_hour, MAX(td.t_shift) AS return_shift FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN time_dim td ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = td.t_time_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_catalog_page_sk ), sales_agg AS ( SELECT cr.cr_catalog_page_sk, SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS total_sales, SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS total_sold_qty, AVG(td2.t_hour) AS avg_sale_hour, MAX(td2.t_shift) AS sale_shift FROM store_sales ss JOIN catalog_returns cr ON ss.ss_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk JOIN time_dim td2 ON ss.ss_sold_time_sk = td2.t_time_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_catalog_page_sk ) SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id, cp.cp_department, cp.cp_type, COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(r.total_net_loss, 0) AS total_net_loss, COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_net_loss, 0) AS net_profit, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_net_loss, 0) > 10000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_net_loss, 0) BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS profit_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(r.total_net_loss, 0) DESC) AS profit_rank, r.avg_return_hour, s.avg_sale_hour, r.return_shift, s.sale_shift FROM catalog_page cp LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = r.cr_catalog_page_sk LEFT JOIN sales_agg s ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = s.cr_catalog_page_sk WHERE cp.cp_department IS NOT NULL ORDER BY net_profit DESC LIMIT 10

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT ws_item_sk, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk) AS distinct_customers FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_item_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT wr_item_sk, SUM(wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount FROM web_returns GROUP BY wr_item_sk ) SELECT s.ws_item_sk, s.total_sales, s.total_profit, s.distinct_customers, COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount, CASE WHEN s.distinct_customers > 0 THEN COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) / s.distinct_customers ELSE 0 END AS return_per_customer, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.distinct_customers DESC) AS customer_rank FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.ws_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk WHERE s.total_profit > 0 ORDER BY customer_rank LIMIT 10

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT ws_item_sk, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, AVG(ws_net_profit) AS avg_profit FROM web_sales WHERE ws_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 20000101 AND 20001231 GROUP BY ws_item_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT wr_item_sk, COUNT(*) AS return_count FROM web_returns WHERE wr_returned_date_sk >= 20000101 GROUP BY wr_item_sk ) SELECT s.ws_item_sk, s.total_sales, s.avg_profit, COALESCE(r.return_count,0) AS return_count, CASE WHEN s.total_sales > 0 THEN COALESCE(r.return_count,0) / s.total_sales ELSE 0 END AS return_per_sale, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.avg_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.ws_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 15

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT ws_item_sk, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, MAX(ws_ext_sales_price) AS max_sale FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_item_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT wr_item_sk, SUM(wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount, MIN(wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS min_return FROM web_returns GROUP BY wr_item_sk ) SELECT s.ws_item_sk, s.total_sales, s.total_profit, s.max_sale, COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount, COALESCE(r.min_return,0) AS min_return, CASE WHEN s.max_sale > 5000 THEN 'BIG' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS sale_size, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN s.max_sale > 5000 THEN 'BIG' ELSE 'SMALL' END ORDER BY s.total_profit DESC) AS partitioned_profit_rank FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.ws_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk ORDER BY partitioned_profit_rank LIMIT 20

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT ws_item_sk, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(ws_quantity) AS total_qty FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_item_sk ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT wr_item_sk, SUM(wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount, SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS total_return_qty FROM web_returns GROUP BY wr_item_sk ) SELECT s.ws_item_sk, s.total_sales, s.total_profit, s.total_qty, COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount, COALESCE(r.total_return_qty,0) AS total_return_qty, (COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) / NULLIF(s.total_sales,0)) * 100 AS return_percent, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.ws_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk WHERE s.total_qty > 10 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 25

WITH sales_agg AS ( SELECT ws_item_sk, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS total_profit FROM web_sales GROUP BY ws_item_sk HAVING SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) > 10000 ), returns_agg AS ( SELECT wr_item_sk, SUM(wr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS total_return_amount FROM web_returns GROUP BY wr_item_sk ) SELECT s.ws_item_sk, s.total_sales, s.total_profit, COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) AS total_return_amount, CASE WHEN s.total_sales > 0 THEN COALESCE(r.total_return_amount,0) / s.total_sales ELSE 0 END AS return_ratio, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_quartile FROM sales_agg s LEFT JOIN returns_agg r ON s.ws_item_sk = r.wr_item_sk ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS bill_customer_id,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount_amount,
       AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_per_sale,
       COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS email_promo_transactions,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_email_promo,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_brand) AS distinct_brands_purchased,
       CASE WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 150000 THEN 'Platinum'
            WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 80000 THEN 'Gold'
            WHEN SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 30000 THEN 'Silver'
            ELSE 'Bronze' END AS customer_tier,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank
FROM catalog_sales cs
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 2450815 AND 2451200
GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY total_net_profit ASC
LIMIT 15

SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS bill_customer_id,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount_amount,
       AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_per_sale,
       COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tv_promo_transactions,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN cs.cs_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS tv_promo_profit,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_tv_promo,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_category) AS distinct_categories_purchased,
       PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_percent_rank
FROM catalog_sales cs
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
HAVING SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) > 5000
ORDER BY tv_promo_profit DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS bill_customer_id,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount_amount,
       AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_per_sale,
       COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_channel_catalog = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS catalog_promo_transactions,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_channel_catalog = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_catalog_promo,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_size) AS distinct_sizes_purchased,
       MAX(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) AS last_sale_date_sk,
       CASE WHEN MAX(cs.cs_sold_date_sk) > 2451500 THEN 'Recent' ELSE 'Older' END AS recency_flag
FROM catalog_sales cs
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE cs.cs_ext_tax > 0
GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY last_sale_date_sk DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS bill_customer_id,
       SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) AS total_net_profit,
       SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount_amount,
       MIN(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS min_discount_per_sale,
       MAX(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS max_discount_per_sale,
       COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS radio_promo_transactions,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_radio_promo,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.i_category) AS distinct_categories_purchased,
       NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_quartile
FROM catalog_sales cs
LEFT JOIN promotion p ON cs.cs_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
HAVING SUM(cs.cs_net_profit) > 20000
ORDER BY total_transactions DESC
LIMIT 25

WITH daily_profit AS ( SELECT c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date, SUM(s.ss_net_profit) AS daily_profit, SUM(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicle_count FROM store_sales s JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center c ON c.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON s.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date ) SELECT cc_call_center_id, d_date, daily_profit, total_vehicle_count, SUM(daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date) AS cumulative_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date) > 1000000 THEN 'Target Exceeded' ELSE 'Below Target' END AS profit_flag FROM daily_profit ORDER BY cc_call_center_id, d_date

WITH store_country_sales AS ( SELECT s.ss_store_sk, c.cc_country, SUM(s.ss_ext_sales_price) AS country_sales, AVG(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS avg_vehicle_count FROM store_sales s JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center c ON c.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON s.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY s.ss_store_sk, c.cc_country ) SELECT ss_store_sk, cc_country, country_sales, avg_vehicle_count, country_sales * 100.0 / SUM(country_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk) AS sales_pct, CASE WHEN country_sales * 100.0 / SUM(country_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk) > 20 THEN 'Major Contributor' ELSE 'Minor Contributor' END AS contribution_flag FROM store_country_sales ORDER BY ss_store_sk, country_sales DESC

SELECT hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential, AVG(s.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_amt, AVG(s.ss_net_paid) AS avg_net_paid, AVG(s.ss_net_paid) * (1 + MAX(c.cc_tax_percentage) / 100) AS net_paid_including_tax, CASE WHEN AVG(s.ss_ext_discount_amt) > 50 THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Low/Medium Discount' END AS discount_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(s.ss_ext_discount_amt) DESC) AS discount_rank FROM store_sales s JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON s.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN call_center c ON c.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2021 GROUP BY hd.hd_demo_sk, hd.hd_buy_potential ORDER BY avg_discount_amt DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.cc_call_center_id, c.cc_name, c.cc_city, c.cc_state, COUNT(DISTINCT hd.hd_demo_sk) AS distinct_demo_count, SUM(s.ss_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(s.ss_net_profit) > 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN SUM(s.ss_net_profit) > 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS profit_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.ss_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank FROM store_sales s JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center c ON c.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON s.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY c.cc_call_center_id, c.cc_name, c.cc_city, c.cc_state HAVING SUM(s.ss_net_profit) > 0 ORDER BY total_net_profit DESC LIMIT 5

WITH latest_cc AS ( SELECT cc_state, cc_call_center_id, cc_name, cc_open_date_sk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_state ORDER BY cc_open_date_sk DESC) AS rn FROM call_center ) SELECT l.cc_state, l.cc_call_center_id, l.cc_name, d_open.d_date AS open_date, COALESCE(SUM(s.ss_ext_sales_price), 0) AS total_sales, AVG(hd.hd_income_band_sk) AS avg_income_band, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.ss_ext_sales_price), 0) > 500000 THEN 'High Sales State' ELSE 'Low/Medium Sales State' END AS sales_category FROM latest_cc l JOIN date_dim d_open ON l.cc_open_date_sk = d_open.d_date_sk LEFT JOIN store_sales s ON s.ss_sold_date_sk >= l.cc_open_date_sk LEFT JOIN household_demographics hd ON s.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk WHERE l.rn = 1 GROUP BY l.cc_state, l.cc_call_center_id, l.cc_name, d_open.d_date ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10
