WITH monthly_avg AS ( SELECT hd.hd_income_band_sk, d.d_year, d.d_moy, AVG(s.ss_sales_price) AS avg_sales_price, COUNT(*) AS sales_cnt FROM store_sales s JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON s.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk JOIN call_center c ON c.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_year = 2020 GROUP BY hd.hd_income_band_sk, d.d_year, d.d_moy HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ) SELECT hd_income_band_sk, d_year, d_moy AS month, avg_sales_price, LAG(avg_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY d_year, d_moy) AS prev_month_avg_price, CASE WHEN avg_sales_price > COALESCE(LAG(avg_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY hd_income_band_sk ORDER BY d_year, d_moy), 0) * 1.1 THEN 'Significant Increase' ELSE 'Stable/Decrease' END AS price_trend, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_sales_price DESC) AS price_rank FROM monthly_avg ORDER BY avg_sales_price DESC

SELECT wp.wp_web_page_id, c.d_date AS creation_date, a.d_date AS access_date, date_diff('day', c.d_date, a.d_date) AS days_to_access, CASE WHEN a.d_date = c.d_date THEN 'Same Day' WHEN date_diff('day', c.d_date, a.d_date) <= 7 THEN 'Within Week' ELSE 'Later' END AS access_timing_category, wp.wp_char_count, wp.wp_link_count, wp.wp_image_count, LAG(wp.wp_link_count) OVER (PARTITION BY wp.wp_web_page_id ORDER BY a.d_date) AS prev_link_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_date ORDER BY wp.wp_link_count DESC) AS daily_link_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.d_date ORDER BY wp.wp_char_count DESC) AS daily_char_dense_rank FROM web_page wp JOIN date_dim c ON wp.wp_creation_date_sk = c.d_date_sk JOIN date_dim a ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = a.d_date_sk WHERE a.d_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' ORDER BY a.d_date DESC, daily_link_rank

WITH inv_monthly AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty, AVG(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_qty, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN d.d_holiday = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Holiday' ELSE 'Regular' END AS day_type FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, d.d_year, d.d_month_seq ) SELECT w_warehouse_name, d_year, d_month_seq, total_qty, avg_qty, day_type, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY avg_qty DESC) AS warehouse_rank_by_avg_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_year ORDER BY total_qty DESC) AS warehouse_rownum_by_total_qty FROM inv_monthly ORDER BY d_year, warehouse_rank_by_avg_qty

WITH wh_stats AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, COUNT(DISTINCT d.d_date) AS active_days, AVG(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS avg_daily_qty, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS total_qty FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN warehouse w ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023 GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city ) SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_city, active_days, avg_daily_qty, total_qty / NULLIF(active_days, 0) AS turnover_rate, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_qty DESC) AS warehouse_turnover_rank, CASE WHEN avg_daily_qty >= 1000 THEN 'High Stock' WHEN avg_daily_qty BETWEEN 500 AND 999 THEN 'Medium Stock' ELSE 'Low Stock' END AS stock_category FROM wh_stats ORDER BY warehouse_turnover_rank

WITH daily_inventory AS ( SELECT d.d_date_sk, d.d_date, SUM(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS daily_total_inv FROM inventory i JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk GROUP BY d.d_date_sk, d.d_date ), daily_page_access AS ( SELECT a.d_date_sk, a.d_date, COUNT(wp.wp_web_page_id) AS daily_page_accesses FROM web_page wp JOIN date_dim a ON wp.wp_access_date_sk = a.d_date_sk GROUP BY a.d_date_sk, a.d_date ) SELECT di.d_date, di.daily_total_inv, dpa.daily_page_accesses, SUM(di.daily_total_inv) OVER (PARTITION BY year(di.d_date) ORDER BY di.d_date) AS cumulative_inv_year, SUM(dpa.daily_page_accesses) OVER (PARTITION BY year(dpa.d_date) ORDER BY dpa.d_date) AS cumulative_page_accesses_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY di.daily_total_inv DESC) AS inv_day_rank, CASE WHEN di.daily_total_inv > 10000 THEN 'High Inventory' WHEN di.daily_total_inv BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Inventory' ELSE 'Low Inventory' END AS inventory_category FROM daily_inventory di LEFT JOIN daily_page_access dpa ON di.d_date_sk = dpa.d_date_sk WHERE di.d_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' ORDER BY di.d_date

WITH pages_per_date AS ( SELECT wp.wp_creation_date_sk, COUNT(*) AS pages_created FROM web_page wp GROUP BY wp.wp_creation_date_sk ), inv_daily_warehouse AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_name, d.d_date, d.d_date_sk, i.inv_quantity_on_hand, LAG(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY d.d_date) AS prev_qty, LEAD(i.inv_quantity_on_hand) OVER (PARTITION BY w.w_warehouse_sk ORDER BY d.d_date) AS next_qty FROM inventory i JOIN warehouse w ON i.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN date_dim d ON i.inv_date_sk = d.d_date_sk ) SELECT idw.w_warehouse_name, idw.d_date, idw.inv_quantity_on_hand, idw.prev_qty, idw.next_qty, (idw.inv_quantity_on_hand - COALESCE(idw.prev_qty,0)) AS qty_change_from_prev, CASE WHEN pd.pages_created IS NOT NULL THEN 'Page Created' ELSE 'No Page' END AS page_creation_flag, COALESCE(pd.pages_created,0) AS pages_created_today, SUM(COALESCE(pd.pages_created,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY idw.w_warehouse_name ORDER BY idw.d_date) AS cumulative_pages_created FROM inv_daily_warehouse idw LEFT JOIN pages_per_date pd ON idw.d_date_sk = pd.wp_creation_date_sk WHERE idw.d_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' ORDER BY idw.w_warehouse_name, idw.d_date

WITH cust_stats AS ( SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount, AVG(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS avg_return_qty, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name ) SELECT cs.c_customer_id, cs.c_first_name, cs.c_last_name, cs.total_net_loss, cs.total_return_amount, cs.avg_return_qty, cs.return_cnt, CASE WHEN cs.total_net_loss > 15000 THEN 'High Loss' WHEN cs.total_net_loss BETWEEN 8000 AND 15000 THEN 'Medium Loss' ELSE 'Low Loss' END AS loss_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_net_loss DESC) AS loss_rank FROM cust_stats cs WHERE cs.return_cnt >= 5 ORDER BY loss_rank LIMIT 20

WITH reason_per_ship AS ( SELECT cr.cr_ship_mode_sk, r.r_reason_desc, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_ship_mode_sk, r.r_reason_desc ), ranked_reasons AS ( SELECT rps.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rps.cr_ship_mode_sk ORDER BY rps.cnt DESC) AS reason_rank FROM reason_per_ship rps ) SELECT rr.cr_ship_mode_sk, rr.r_reason_desc, rr.cnt, rr.reason_rank FROM ranked_reasons rr WHERE rr.reason_rank = 1 ORDER BY rr.cr_ship_mode_sk

WITH hourly_stats AS ( SELECT t.t_hour, AVG(cr.cr_return_amount) AS avg_return_amt, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, COUNT(*) AS return_cnt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY t.t_hour ) SELECT hs.t_hour, hs.avg_return_amt, hs.total_net_loss, hs.return_cnt, CASE WHEN hs.avg_return_amt >= (SELECT AVG(cr_return_amount) FROM catalog_returns) THEN 'Peak' ELSE 'Off-Peak' END AS period_category, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hs.total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank FROM hourly_stats hs ORDER BY hs.t_hour

WITH reason_hour AS ( SELECT r.r_reason_desc, t.t_hour, SUM(cr.cr_net_loss) AS total_net_loss, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS total_return_amount FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc, t.t_hour ) SELECT rh.r_reason_desc, rh.t_hour, rh.total_net_loss, rh.total_return_amount, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rh.total_net_loss DESC) AS net_loss_rank FROM reason_hour rh ORDER BY net_loss_rank, rh.r_reason_desc, rh.t_hour

WITH ordered_returns AS ( SELECT cr.cr_order_number, cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, cr.cr_returned_time_sk, cr.cr_net_loss, c.c_customer_id, t.t_hour, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk ORDER BY cr.cr_returned_time_sk) AS rn FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN time_dim t ON cr.cr_returned_time_sk = t.t_time_sk ) SELECT orr.cr_order_number, orr.c_customer_id, orr.t_hour, orr.cr_net_loss, LAG(orr.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY orr.cr_returning_customer_sk ORDER BY orr.rn) AS prev_net_loss, (orr.cr_net_loss - LAG(orr.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY orr.cr_returning_customer_sk ORDER BY orr.rn)) AS net_loss_diff, SUM(orr.cr_net_loss) OVER (PARTITION BY orr.cr_returning_customer_sk ORDER BY orr.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_net_loss FROM ordered_returns orr WHERE orr.rn > 1 ORDER BY orr.c_customer_id, orr.rn LIMIT 200

WITH cust_reason_totals AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS reason_return_amt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, r.r_reason_desc ), cust_agg AS ( SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk, c_customer_id, SUM(reason_return_amt) AS total_return_amt, COUNT(*) AS distinct_reason_cnt FROM cust_reason_totals GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, c_customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ), ranked_reasons AS ( SELECT crt.cr_returning_customer_sk, crt.c_customer_id, crt.r_reason_desc, crt.reason_return_amt, ca.total_return_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY crt.cr_returning_customer_sk ORDER BY crt.reason_return_amt DESC) AS rn, (crt.reason_return_amt / ca.total_return_amt) AS return_ratio FROM cust_reason_totals crt JOIN cust_agg ca ON crt.cr_returning_customer_sk = ca.cr_returning_customer_sk ) SELECT rr.c_customer_id, rr.r_reason_desc, rr.reason_return_amt, rr.total_return_amt, rr.return_ratio, rr.rn AS reason_rank FROM ranked_reasons rr WHERE rr.rn <= 2 ORDER BY rr.c_customer_id, rr.rn

WITH daily_profit AS ( SELECT c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date, SUM(s.ss_net_profit) AS daily_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT s.ss_customer_sk) AS unique_customers FROM store_sales s JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center c ON c.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk WHERE d.d_weekend = 'N' GROUP BY c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date ) SELECT cc_call_center_id, d_date, daily_profit, unique_customers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY daily_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM daily_profit WHERE daily_profit > 0 ORDER BY profit_rank, cc_call_center_id

WITH daily_profit AS ( SELECT c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date, SUM(s.ss_net_profit) AS daily_profit, SUM(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicle_count FROM store_sales s JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center c ON c.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON s.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date HAVING SUM(s.ss_net_profit) > 10000 ) SELECT cc_call_center_id, d_date, daily_profit, total_vehicle_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date) AS day_seq FROM daily_profit ORDER BY cc_call_center_id, day_seq

WITH daily_profit AS ( SELECT c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date, SUM(s.ss_net_profit) AS daily_profit, SUM(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicle_count FROM store_sales s JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center c ON c.cc_closed_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON s.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk WHERE d.d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 GROUP BY c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date ) SELECT cc_call_center_id, d_date, daily_profit, total_vehicle_count, AVG(daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seven_day_avg_profit, CASE WHEN daily_profit > 50000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS profit_level FROM daily_profit ORDER BY cc_call_center_id, d_date DESC

WITH daily_profit AS ( SELECT c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date, SUM(s.ss_net_profit) AS daily_profit, SUM(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicle_count FROM store_sales s JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center c ON c.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON s.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date ) SELECT cc_call_center_id, d_date, daily_profit, total_vehicle_count, LAG(daily_profit, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date) AS prev_day_profit, (daily_profit - LAG(daily_profit, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date)) / NULLIF(LAG(daily_profit, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date), 0) * 100 AS profit_change_pct FROM daily_profit WHERE d_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' ORDER BY cc_call_center_id, d_date

WITH daily_profit AS ( SELECT c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date, SUM(s.ss_net_profit) AS daily_profit, SUM(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicle_count FROM store_sales s JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center c ON c.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON s.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk WHERE c.cc_state = 'CA' GROUP BY c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date ) SELECT cc_call_center_id, d_date, daily_profit, total_vehicle_count, SUM(daily_profit) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cc_call_center_id) AS avg_cumulative_profit FROM daily_profit ORDER BY avg_cumulative_profit DESC LIMIT 10

WITH daily_profit AS ( SELECT c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date, SUM(s.ss_net_profit) AS daily_profit, SUM(hd.hd_vehicle_count) AS total_vehicle_count FROM store_sales s JOIN date_dim d ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN call_center c ON c.cc_open_date_sk = d.d_date_sk JOIN household_demographics hd ON s.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk GROUP BY c.cc_call_center_id, d.d_date ) SELECT cc_call_center_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', d_date) AS month, SUM(daily_profit) AS month_profit, SUM(total_vehicle_count) AS month_vehicle_total, CASE WHEN SUM(daily_profit) > 200000 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN SUM(daily_profit) > 100000 THEN 'Good' ELSE 'Average' END AS performance_category FROM daily_profit GROUP BY cc_call_center_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', d_date) HAVING SUM(daily_profit) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY month_profit DESC

WITH cust_reason_totals AS ( SELECT cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, r.r_reason_desc, SUM(cr.cr_return_amount) AS reason_return_amt FROM catalog_returns cr JOIN customer c ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk JOIN reason r ON cr.cr_reason_sk = r.r_reason_sk WHERE cr.cr_return_quantity > 1 GROUP BY cr.cr_returning_customer_sk, c.c_customer_id, r.r_reason_desc ), cust_agg AS ( SELECT cr_returning_customer_sk, c_customer_id, AVG(reason_return_amt) AS avg_return_amt FROM cust_reason_totals GROUP BY cr_returning_customer_sk, c_customer_id ), ranked_reasons AS ( SELECT crt.cr_returning_customer_sk, crt.c_customer_id, crt.r_reason_desc, crt.reason_return_amt, ca.avg_return_amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY crt.cr_returning_customer_sk ORDER BY crt.reason_return_amt ASC) AS rn, (crt.reason_return_amt / ca.avg_return_amt) AS return_vs_avg FROM cust_reason_totals crt JOIN cust_agg ca ON crt.cr_returning_customer_sk = ca.cr_returning_customer_sk ) SELECT rr.c_customer_id, rr.r_reason_desc, rr.reason_return_amt, rr.avg_return_amt, rr.return_vs_avg, rr.rn FROM ranked_reasons rr WHERE rr.rn <= 2 ORDER BY rr.return_vs_avg DESC

WITH promo_sales AS ( SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_channel_tv, p.p_channel_email, MIN(sm.sm_ship_mode_id) AS ship_mode_id, MIN(w.w_warehouse_name) AS warehouse_name, COUNT(ws.ws_order_number) AS total_orders, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, CASE WHEN p.p_discount_active = 'Y' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN DATE '1970-01-01' + (p.p_start_date_sk * INTERVAL '1' DAY) AND DATE '1970-01-01' + (p.p_end_date_sk * INTERVAL '1' DAY) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS promo_status FROM promotion p JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.p_channel_tv, p.p_channel_email, p.p_discount_active, p.p_start_date_sk, p.p_end_date_sk ) SELECT p.p_promo_id, p.p_promo_name, p.promo_status, p.total_orders, p.total_net_profit, p.total_discount, p.avg_discount, p.ship_mode_id, p.warehouse_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.total_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY p.avg_discount ASC) AS discount_rank FROM promo_sales p ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10

WITH warehouse_perf AS ( SELECT w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, w.w_state, MIN(p.p_promo_id) AS sample_promo, MIN(sm.sm_ship_mode_id) AS ship_mode_id, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS warehouse_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS warehouse_sales, SUM(ws.ws_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS distinct_orders, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount FROM web_sales ws JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_id, w.w_warehouse_name, w.w_city, w.w_state ) SELECT wp.w_warehouse_id, wp.w_warehouse_name, wp.w_city, wp.w_state, wp.warehouse_net_profit, wp.warehouse_sales, wp.total_quantity, wp.distinct_orders, wp.avg_discount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wp.warehouse_net_profit DESC) AS profit_rank, SUM(wp.warehouse_net_profit) OVER (ORDER BY wp.warehouse_net_profit DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / SUM(wp.warehouse_net_profit) OVER () * 100 AS cumulative_profit_pct, wp.sample_promo, wp.ship_mode_id FROM warehouse_perf wp ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10

WITH promo_warehouse AS ( SELECT p.p_purpose, w.w_state, SUM(ws.ws_net_paid) AS total_net_paid, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.ws_order_number) AS orders, CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) / SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) END AS profit_per_discount FROM web_sales ws JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk GROUP BY p.p_purpose, w.w_state ) SELECT pw.p_purpose, pw.w_state, pw.total_net_paid, pw.total_discount, pw.total_net_profit, pw.orders, pw.profit_per_discount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pw.p_purpose ORDER BY pw.total_net_profit DESC) AS state_profit_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pw.p_purpose ORDER BY pw.total_net_paid) AS net_paid_percentile FROM promo_warehouse pw WHERE pw.total_net_profit > 0 ORDER BY pw.p_purpose, state_profit_rank LIMIT 20

SELECT sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_type, MIN(w.w_state) AS warehouse_state, MIN(p.p_promo_name) AS sample_promo, COUNT(ws.ws_order_number) AS total_orders, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, CASE WHEN SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) > 0 THEN SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) / SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) ELSE NULL END AS profit_per_discount_ratio, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sm.sm_type ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) DESC) AS type_rank FROM web_sales ws JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk WHERE ws.ws_ext_discount_amt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sm.sm_ship_mode_id, sm.sm_type ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' WHEN p.p_channel_catalog = 'Y' THEN 'Catalog' WHEN p.p_channel_event = 'Y' THEN 'Event' ELSE 'Other' END AS primary_channel, MIN(p.p_promo_name) AS promo_name, COUNT(ws.ws_order_number) AS total_orders, SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) AS total_net_profit, AVG(ws.ws_net_profit) AS avg_net_profit, SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS total_discount, AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) DESC) AS profit_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) ASC) AS discount_rank, MIN(sm.sm_ship_mode_id) AS representative_ship_mode, MIN(w.w_warehouse_name) AS representative_warehouse FROM web_sales ws JOIN promotion p ON ws.ws_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk JOIN ship_mode sm ON ws.ws_ship_mode_sk = sm.sm_ship_mode_sk JOIN warehouse w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk GROUP BY CASE WHEN p.p_channel_tv = 'Y' THEN 'TV' WHEN p.p_channel_email = 'Y' THEN 'Email' WHEN p.p_channel_radio = 'Y' THEN 'Radio' WHEN p.p_channel_catalog = 'Y' THEN 'Catalog' WHEN p.p_channel_event = 'Y' THEN 'Event' ELSE 'Other' END HAVING SUM(ws.ws_net_profit) > 0 ORDER BY profit_rank LIMIT 10
